source.title: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

items.name: Attack of Opportunity
items.text:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

---

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

items.name: Divert Strike
items.text:
Trigger A shatterling takes non-bludgeoning damage and there's an unbroken mirror at least 1 foot wide within 100 feet of the shatterling

---

Effect The nearest mirror to the shatterling at least 1 foot wide breaks, and the damage to the shatterling is reduced to 0.

items.name: Extra Reaction
items.text: A shatterling gains an additional reaction each turn, but can use this extra reaction only for Divert Strike.

items.name: Mirror Senses
items.text: A shatterling can see and hear through any unbroken mirror within 100 feet.

items.name: Blood-Fueled Titter
items.text: If the shatterling attempts an Intimidation check to demoralize a target within 30 feet of a creature with persistent bleed damage, the shatterling has +4 circumstance bonus to the Intimidation check. In addition, the shatterling takes no penalty to the check for not speaking a language the target can hear, and the target isn't temporarily immune to the shatterling's attempts to Demoralize it unless the shatterling critically fails its Intimidation check.

items.name: Mirror Jump
items.text: During this Stride, the shatterling can move into any unbroken mirror at least 1 foot wide and out of another unbroken mirror at least 1 foot wide within 100 feet of the first mirror, treating the mirrors as connected. The shatterling can move through any number of pairs of foot-wide mirrors during its mirror jump, requiring each pair to be within 100 feet of each other while doing so.

items.name: Vanish in Reflections
items.text: The shatterling doesn't appear in reflective surfaces if it doesn't want to. When it's within 100 feet of an unbroken mirror at least 1 foot wide, a shatterling can Hide and Sneak even without cover or without being concealed.

items.name: Wipe Away Cracks
items.text: The shatterling touches a broken mirror, instantly repairing it.
